Aqua: Cool, calm, and minimal. Great for anyone seeking a clean, simple, and soothing experience.
Cobalt: Deep, professional, and reliable. It conveys trust and focus, making it a strong match for more serious and professional users.
Myket Default: Familiar, clear, and balanced. This is Myket’s signature style. Simple, functional, and trustworthy, designed for a smooth and consistent experience.
System Default: Matches your device. This option automatically adapts to the accent color set in your phone’s system settings.
Jungle: Balanced and refreshing. A great fit for people who appreciate a sense of nature, freshness, and tranquility.
Orange: Warm, friendly, and energetic. Perfect for those who love a positive, active vibe with a touch of closeness.
Pinky: Playful, soft, and emotional. A sweet, joyful choice for those who enjoy whimsical and fantasy-inspired spaces.
Red: Bold, powerful, and eye-catching. If you want a color that stands out and delivers a sense of strength and excitement, red is your pick.
Violet: Mysterious, modern, and distinctive. Ideal for anyone looking for a creative, unique theme with a digital, futuristic mood.
